name: Ironwake Gala — Corponation Memorial Centenary
creator: Axiom Consolidated Cultural Division, executive producer Cassian Vreeland-Murthi
description: Held annually in the Spire's Aurelius Atrium on the anniversary of the 2103 Lakeshore Cascade — a catastrophic infrastructure failure that killed an estimated 40,000 people and is credited with accelerating corponation sovereignty over municipal governance — Ironwake is simultaneously a solemn memorial and an obscenely lavish black-tie gala. Guests receive bespoke neural elegies composed specifically for their BCI profile, and the evening culminates in a synchronized aerial holographic requiem visible from Tier 3. The event is invitation-only, with attendance functioning as a soft measure of Spire social standing.
medium: physical / personalized neural feed / holographic aerial display
cultural_impact: Ironwake has become a flashpoint in debates about who owns public grief — critics argue the event launders corponation culpability for the Cascade by aestheticizing the death toll, while Axiom frames it as the definitive act of institutional remembrance.
controversy: Declassified infrastructure reports leaked in 2218 suggested Axiom's predecessor entity suppressed early Cascade warnings for cost reasons; the leak circulated widely on pirate neural feeds during the 2219 Ironwake, causing several invited guests to publicly refuse attendance.
story_hooks: A Tier 1 survivor of the Lakeshore Cascade — now very old — has been smuggled into the Aurelius Atrium by a sympathetic Tier 4 employee, intending to deliver a testimony during the neural elegy broadcast.

The composer hired to create this year's personalized neural elegies has embedded something unauthorized in the grief-response algorithms — something that causes recipients to briefly experience the Cascade from the perspective of those who died.

Two Spire executives use the Ironwake's social calculus as cover for a hostile acquisition negotiation; a junior analyst realizes the deal will result in the demolition of the last standing Cascade memorial in Tier 2.
